$description: XOS color and shadow tokens, dark theme. Selected with [data-theme="dark"].

canvas.$description: Page background behind every shell. Spec token color.bg.canvas.

surface.$description: Sidebar, page header and grouped regions on canvas. Spec token color.bg.surface.

raised.$description: Cards, menus, popovers, side peek and dialogs. Spec token color.bg.raised.

hover.$description: Hover and selected row fill. Every text token passes 4.5:1 on it in every theme (text-tertiary 4.55:1 dark, 4.51:1 light). Spec token color.bg.hover.

subtle.$description: Default 1 px hairline: dividers, card edges, table rules and the ring paired with menu and dialog shadows. Spec token color.border.subtle.

strong.$description: Emphasis dividers, table header rules and selected outlines; decorative only. Control boundaries use border-control. Spec token color.border.strong.

control.$description: Boundary of every input, select, checkbox, radio, switch and segmented control; meets the 3:1 non-text minimum on canvas, surface and raised (3.04:1 dark, 3.02:1 light). Added to resolve WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11.

primary.$description: Titles, body text, values and labels on any background. Spec token color.text.primary.

secondary.$description: Secondary labels, property names, metadata on any background. Spec token color.text.secondary.

tertiary.$description: Input hint text, timestamps and helper text on every background, including bg-hover (4.55:1 dark, 4.51:1 light minimum). Adjusted from the spec's #858892 and #6B6E76, which measured 4.43:1 and 4.44:1 on bg-hover. Spec token color.text.tertiary.

default.$description: Fill role: primary button, active marker, selection, progress. As text use accent-text. Icons on any background pass 3:1. Spec token color.accent.default.

text-on.$description: Label and icon on an accent-default fill (4.78:1 dark, 5.68:1 light). Spec token color.accent.text-on.

text.$description: Text role of the accent: links, selected text, accent labels; 4.5:1 or higher on every background in every theme.

ring.$description: 2 px keyboard focus ring with 2 px offset on every interactive element (6.87:1 dark, 5.68:1 light against canvas). Spec token color.focus.ring.

danger.$description: Fill and icon role for destructive actions, errors, Blocked and critical severity. As text use danger-text. Spec token color.danger.

warning.$description: Fill and icon role for warnings, Deferred and staleness; icons pass 3:1 on every background. As text use warning-text. Spec token color.warning.

success.$description: Fill and icon role for success, Complete and Met; icons pass 3:1 on every background. As text use success-text. Spec token color.success.

danger-text.$description: Text role of danger: error messages, destructive menu items, removed values; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.

danger-text-on.$description: Label and icon on a danger fill, such as a hold-to-send button: the canvas color in every theme (5.73:1 dark, 5.17:1 light, 7.00:1 sunlight). Spec token color.danger-text-on.

warning-text.$description: Text role of warning: countdowns near zero, staleness labels; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.

success-text.$description: Text role of success: added values, confirmations; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.

proposed.$description: Proposed state icon (dashed circle). Hue Neutral.

ready.$description: Ready state icon (empty circle). Hue Neutral strong.

scheduled.$description: Scheduled state icon (clock circle). Hue Blue, from the Okabe-Ito set; 8.31:1 dark and 5.19:1 light on canvas.

active.$description: Active state icon (half circle). Hue Accent; icon use only in dark (3:1 icon threshold met).

in-review.$description: In Review state icon (eye circle). Hue Violet; 7.28:1 dark and 5.45:1 light on canvas.

complete.$description: Complete state icon (check circle). Hue Success.

deferred.$description: Deferred state icon (pause circle). Hue Warning.

canceled.$description: Canceled state icon (slashed circle). Hue Tertiary.

ink.$description: Text and marks on light data-viz fills (viz-seq-1 to 5, viz-cat-1, 2, 4) in every theme.

cat-1.$description: Categorical series 1 of 7: Okabe-Ito Orange, stepped per theme so every adjacent pair passes the CVD, normal-vision and lightness-band checks against its chart surface. Assign in order, never cycled; every series also differs by marker or line style, and every chart has a table view.

Assign in order, never cycled; every series also differs by marker or line style, and every chart has a table view.

other.$description: The Other bucket: series past the seventh fold here, always last and always labeled. Not a series color; it never sits next to a hue it must be told apart from.

seq-1.$description: Sequential step 1 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-2.$description: Sequential step 2 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-3.$description: Sequential step 3 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-4.$description: Sequential step 4 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-5.$description: Sequential step 5 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-6.$description: Sequential step 6 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-7.$description: Sequential step 7 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-8.$description: Sequential step 8 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

seq-9.$description: Sequential step 9 of 9, generated in OKLCH from accent-default (step 6 equals the dark accent). Low to high magnitude.

div-1.$description: Diverging step 1 of 7 (strongest under), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-2.$description: Diverging step 2 of 7 (under), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-3.$description: Diverging step 3 of 7 (slightly under), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-4.$description: Diverging step 4 of 7 (neutral midpoint), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-5.$description: Diverging step 5 of 7 (slightly over), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-6.$description: Diverging step 6 of 7 (over), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

div-7.$description: Diverging step 7 of 7 (strongest over), blue to orange through neutral in OKLab. Variance and budget versus actual.

paper.$description: Printed page surface in document previews; always white, like the printed PDF.

camera-bg.$description: Camera viewfinder ground in Compass scan and photo screens, in every theme.

camera-ink.$description: Reticle and hint text over the camera feed.

red.$description: Swatch for Code Red, Fire Emergency. Identification only, always beside the code name in text; ringed with border-control so light and dark swatches hold their edge. Same in every theme.

orange.$description: Swatch for Code Orange, Acts of Aggression. Identification only, always beside the code name in text; ringed with border-control so light and dark swatches hold their edge. Same in every theme.

blue.$description: Swatch for Code Blue, Medical Emergency. Identification only, always beside the code name in text; ringed with border-control so light and dark swatches hold their edge. Same in every theme.

adam.$description: Swatch for Code Adam, Missing Person(s). Code Adam names no color, so it reads neutral; the code name carries the meaning.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind drawers, dialogs and the mobile sidebar; shown at opacity-scrim-dark in Dark and opacity-scrim-light in Light and Sunlight.

menu.$description: Menus, popovers, hover cards, tooltips, toasts.
